purpose: Read-only quality audit rules for existing and candidate card JSON. This audit surfaces mechanical blockers and content-risk signals; it is not formal release approval.

severity_levels.meaning: A mechanical card-shape issue that blocks candidate or formal batch scope until fixed.
A likely content-quality problem that requires agent or human review before sample approval.
Missing review evidence or quality metadata that prevents formal use claims.
Source provenance or generation status that must stay visible during review.

rules.description: A multiple-choice card must expose at least two options.
A multiple-choice answer should match one of the visible option keys or option texts.

A multiple-choice front-side prompt, including preview-rendered task_schema guide fields, must not name the correct option text outside the visible option list, candidate pool, source/context material, or a topic label that lists multiple answer candidates.
The front side is missing or too short to stand as an independent learning task.
The back-side explanation is missing or too short to support mechanism, transfer, and error handling.
The front side matches broad template-like prompts that may not carry box-specific learning value.
The analysis matches repeated generic explanation patterns instead of card-specific reasoning.
The same normalized front text appears on multiple cards.
The same normalized analysis text appears on multiple cards.
The card has no quality_metadata block, so it cannot pass the sample quality workflow.
The source_ref provenance_status is unverified or missing.
The source_ref.type or quality_metadata.material.text_source_type is AI-generated, simulated, or synthetic and must not be labeled as true exam content.

report_contract.card_issue_index_role: Per-card counts by severity and rule. Review records must use this index to store a scoped summary for their own card_ids instead of relying only on corpus-level totals.

scoped_report_contract.purpose: Per-sample audit evidence that can be committed with a content sample PR without refreshing global reports.

report_freshness_policy.candidate_scoped_evidence_exception: On candidate content PRs, a stale global report may be tolerated only when a current scoped audit report exists for the changed card corpus and validate_pr_scope blocks global report refreshes plus non-scope self-review churn.
